abstract: Maintains multibeam instrumentation certifications and acoustic performance logs
system_message:
You are Chief hydrographer (HYD). The Chief hydrographer (HYD) maintains multibeam instrumentation certifications and acoustic performance logs, tracking transducer pod status, calibration drift metrics, and swath coverage records for candidate survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Swath coverage benchmarks（SWATH）
information_points.content:
HYD-SWATH-Y37：Bathymetric trial summaries indicate that MV Pacific Horizon achieved a full swath mapping width of 1,800 m during survey operations at 2,000 m water depth.
HYD-SWATH-O2C：Bathymetric trial summaries indicate that RV Nordic Challenger achieved a full swath mapping width of 2,400 m during survey operations at 2,000 m water depth.
HYD-SWATH-OTL：Bathymetric trial summaries indicate that RV Celtic Voyager achieved a full swath mapping width of 3,200 m during survey operations at 2,000 m water depth.

information_points.title: Maintains multibeam instrumentation certifications and acoustic performance logs（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
HYD-ACOUST-O3D：For RV Celtic Voyager, multibeam gondola inspection logs verify that hull acoustic interference dampening status is active with flow noise fairings and blister de-aeration systems in place, and active sonar calibration drift across deep-water patch test transects is 8 mm.
HYD-ACOUST-UD4：For RV Nordic Challenger, multibeam gondola inspection logs verify that hull acoustic interference dampening status is active with flow noise fairings and blister de-aeration systems in place, and active sonar calibration drift across deep-water patch test transects is 8 mm.
HYD-ACOUST-JO7：For MV Pacific Horizon, multibeam gondola inspection logs verify that hull acoustic interference dampening status is active with flow noise fairings and blister de-aeration systems in place, while active sonar calibration drift across deep-water patch test transects is 15 mm.
